title: IEICE Transactions author page: Travis N. Blalock (clamped-bit-line sense amplifier)

supports: Closest related prior art: clamped-bit-line sense amplifier whose speed is insensitive to bit-line capacitance. Search returned no DRAM bitline capacitance-neutralisation (negative-capacitance feedback) prior art; other hits were bitline isolation and offset-cancellation patents (US 6618307, US 2023/0036684). Patent snippet notes bitline parasitic capacitance is mostly bitline-to-storage-electrode (via search snippet)
